title: Chapter 182 Yan Lingyun Survives The Catastrophe
content:
Chapter 182 Yan Lingyun Survives The Catastrophe

Those dark forces really made Wan Feng feel a little afraid.

However, it's just a little bit.

Now, her realm is the third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm. Looking at the entire Wood Fairy Realm, she is one of the best masters.

After a long silence, Wan Feng looked at another place, and his eyes suddenly passed through the endless void and came straight to a certain place in the Wood Fairy Realm.

At the same time, a figure suddenly opened his eyes.

"Have you targeted me?"

And on the other side.

Inside a magnificent hall.

Here, the immortal energy is permeated and countless powers of laws are intertwined.

The six figures sat around, and the atmosphere was quite dull.

"What do you think about Huangcheng?"

One of the figures suddenly spoke, breaking the tranquility in the hall.

"Haha, a man who came out of nowhere to win the deserted city dared to openly challenge us. Who gave him the courage?!"

With a bang, another figure stood up directly, looking a little angry.

"Holy Lord Haotian, don't be angry. Since the other party dares to be so arrogant, he must have capital."

At this moment, a crisp female voice rang out.

Hearing this, everyone immediately looked at the slightly slender figure.

"Saint Lord of Immortal Sky, what do you mean is that the other party really has the strength to compete with us?"

The person who asked about the question is the Holy Lord of the Holy Land of Yunhai, one of the three holy places.

Since the sudden fall of the Immortal Holy Land, the Yunhai Holy Land replaced the Immortal Holy Land and became one of the six major forces in the Wood Immortal Realm.

The Holy Lord of the Immortal Sky glanced at everyone present and said, "The power in the Immortal World is complicated. Even if we are alone, we must unite and face difficulties together."

"This force named Huangcheng dares to be so arrogant and domineering in the Wood Fairy World and not take any force seriously. Do you think this Huangcheng will have no strength?"

When everyone asked, they immediately looked solemn.

"Then are we just ignore it and let this deserted city develop freely?"

The reason why they put pressure on Huangcheng is that Huangcheng has developed too fast.

Moreover, the methods are extremely strong and almost crushed all the way.

If the deserted city is allowed to develop, the deserted city will inevitably become their number one enemy.

And just then, a middle-aged man holding a long sword stood up.

Buzz —

The sound of the sword sounded.

The man holding the sword whispered, "You can tell if the Huangcheng has the strength or not."

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone looked at each other, and they kept silent.

The man holding the sword is the leader of the Immortal Sword Sect, one of the two sects.

He is strong, and since someone has tried it personally, everyone will naturally be happy.

After a moment, the meeting ended, and the man holding the sword did not talk nonsense, and went straight towards the direction of the deserted city alone.

.........

Time flies, and a month has passed in a blink of an eye.

On this day, in the deserted city of Xuanling Star Domain.

A terrifying aura soared into the sky from the depths of the deserted city.

People in the world looked at the direction of the deserted city and looked fearful.

The deserted city is another deserted city.

Buzz —

Above the sky, dense dark clouds covered the sky and the sun, and rolling thunder rolled freely inside.

Heavenly Tribulation!

At this time, a beautiful figure slowly flew into the void.

"What's that?"

"It's the city lord's wife!"

Everyone in Huangcheng suddenly looked tense.

The city lord’s wife is about to overcome the tribulation.

Passing the Tribulation, it has been a long time since there has been no strong man in this world who has been able to pass the Tribulation.

Now, someone can finally break the shackles and break through the limits of this world again.

"Dad, is my mother okay?"

Lu Xue looked at the rolling catastrophe clouds above the sky and said with some concern.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng, who was standing beside him, wiped Lu Xue's head and chuckled slowly, "Your mother must be fine."

He said this, but Lu Daosheng's eyes still had a hint of worry.

Because that catastrophe cloud was even more terrifying than he thought.

"Why is this happening?"

[Master, if your wife just broke through the realm, this Tribulation Cloud would not be so strong]

[But what your wife wants to do is to truly break through the limits of this world. If you want to do this, you must break the rules of this world. In this way, your wife will inevitably anger the will of this world, so God The disaster is so terrifying]

Hearing the systematic explanation, Lu Daosheng immediately understood.

"Then if I threaten the will of this world, will this heavenly tribulation be smaller?"

This world's heavenly way:...

[Master, you can do this, of course, but the stronger the heavenly tribulation, the more benefits you will get after the tribulation, so please think twice before doing it]

Is there any benefit to experiencing a tribulation?

Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned, unexpectedly.

Since this is the case, I can't interfere with my wife's tribulation.

Looking up at Yan Lingyun in the void, Lu Daosheng had to cheer up his wife in his heart.

Wife, I believe in you, you can.

Rumble!

At this moment, the rolling clouds suddenly began to buzz.

Yan Lingyun's expression was a little solemn. Even though she was now extremely powerful, she was still extremely scared when facing this disaster.

The more powerful the combat power is, the more difficult it is to overcome the tribulation.

Countless geniuses who were once amazing and beautiful, stopped here, and Yan Lingyun would never follow in the footsteps.

Her journey is still long.

"bring it on!"

Yan Lingyun shouted coldly.

The calamity cloud seemed to have heard it, and with a bang, a thunder calamity as thick as a bucket fell straight towards Yan Lingyun.

Boom!

Yan Lingyun groaned, and hurriedly sat cross-legged in the void to practice the skills.

After a long time, the thunder calamity dissipated.

The entire void was suddenly filled with countless terrifying thunder laws.

"Madam succeeded in overcoming the calamity, succeeded!"

Below, everyone in the deserted city cheered when they saw the thunder calamity dissipate.

But the top masters still looked at the calamity cloud above the sky with a solemn expression.

The calamity cloud has not dissipated, and the calamity has not ended.

Sure enough, after a moment of silence, the calamity cloud buzzed again.

Boom!

Another thunder calamity fell, three times more terrifying than the previous one.

Yan Lingyun frowned, but she was still able to survive.

At this time, below, Lu Xue had shrunk behind Lu Daosheng, looking at the terrifying thunder calamity in the void with some timidity.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"Xiaoxue, you will definitely accept it in the future, it's just a matter of time."

Hearing this, Lu Xue shook her head repeatedly.

"Dad, can't I not go through the tribulation?"

People who practice cultivation are most afraid of thunder tribulation, and Lu Xue is no exception.

But Lu Daosheng still shook his head, "Going through the tribulation is good for you. You are my daughter, Lu Daosheng, how can you be afraid of this mere thunder tribulation."

Hearing her father's words, Lu Xue's eyes were filled with grievance.

However, Lu Daosheng had already turned his head away.

Seeing this, Lu Xue pouted, and then whispered: "Forget it, I'm not afraid. At worst, I'll let Xiaoqing help me carry it. Anyway, he has thick skin and flesh."

Suddenly, Ao Qing's eyes widened.

It's over.
